description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
Left-to-right chain, unipolar one-hot slots + saturating gates: amplitude drifted in layer 4 (LN mean shrink), fails (row corrected: later bipolar fix overwrote it).

Left-to-right evaluation (circuit is LTR): 4 layers each compute running value S_l=op(S_{l-1},digit) via attention to p-1/p-2 and saturating AND-gate lookup MLP; bipolar bit codes; 5th layer copies result to '='.
chain5L_bipolar trimmed to d_ff=28 (28 neurons actually used).
Same LTR chain with bipolar bits, but each AND-gate is a single ReLU neuron (d_ff=14) instead of a saturating pair.
Single-ReLU chain with A=13, K=60 (LayerNorm-pinning constant).
LTR chain, bipolar bits, single-ReLU gates (d_ff=14), no LayerNorm-pinning constant dims (K=0, A=4): fails.
LTR chain, bipolar bits, single-ReLU gates (d_ff=14), smaller LayerNorm-pinning constant (K=30, A=7, a0=1).
K30 single-ReLU chain with softer attention (c=40) to check attention-sharpness margin.
K30 single-ReLU chain with much softer attention (c=15): first errors appear (98.5%).
K30 single-ReLU chain with attention sharpness c=25.
Ablation: remove the 2 position-0 carry neurons (d_ff=12); still 100% because only the diagonal S_1[2]->S_2[4]->S_3[6]->S_4[8] is ever read.
LTR chain: 4 blocks (12 ReLU lookup neurons each, bipolar bits) + final copy block. Carry neurons removed (not needed: only diagonal chain matters).
LTR chain with 4 blocks: blocks 1-3 compute S_1..S_3 on the diagonal; block 4 at '=' reads S_3 (p-3), op (p-2), digit (p-1) and applies the last op directly (3 heads). 12 ReLU neurons/block.
chain4L_direct_last with compacted residual (d_model=42): operator-at-p-1 copied once and shared by blocks 1-3, no EQ/S_4 slots.
chain4L_d42 with only 2 heads: in the last block one head attends p-1 and p-2 simultaneously (digit and operator live in disjoint slots) and a second head fetches S_3 at p-3.
chain4L_d42_2heads with gate threshold 2.8 (vs 2.4): tests threshold margin (wrong-op input is <=2a, match is 4a).
chain4L_d42_2heads with gate threshold 1.9, below the 2a wrong-op input level: leaks (negative control, 47%).
chain4L_d42_2heads (theta back to 2.4) with all amplitudes doubled (A=14, K=60): scale-invariance check.
chain4L_d42_2heads with amplitudes halved (A=3.5, K=15, A/K=0.233).
chain4L_d42_2heads with A=1.5, K=6 (A/K=0.25, a bit higher than 0.233): fails, so the A/K ratio matters.
chain4L_d42_2heads with A/K=0.2 (A=3, K=15): fails with single-ReLU gates (loop gain <1).
chain4L_d42_2heads (A=7,K=30) with ReLU gain set to unit loop gain at a~0.95 (eps=1.4 = 4a-theta).
chain4L_d42_2heads with saturating 2-ReLU gates (d_ff=24) at A/K=0.2 (A=3,K=15), where single-ReLU gates failed: saturating gates tolerate it.
chain4L_d42_2heads with saturating 2-ReLU gates (d_ff=24) at A/K=0.25 (A=2.5,K=10): still fails (same 46.5% as other A/K=0.25 runs; cause not isolated).
Final LTR chain: 4 blocks, d_model=42, 2 heads, 12 single-ReLU lookup neurons per block (S_prev x op x digit -> next S, bipolar bit codes); last block applies final op directly at '='.
chain4L_final with A=9, K=40 (A/K=0.225): neighbouring operating point to A/K=0.233.
chain4L_final (A=7,K=30) with gate theta=2.6, eps=1.2.
chain4L_final (A=7,K=30, theta=2.6, eps=1.2) with very sharp attention c=80: collapses to 46.5% (cause not isolated).
chain4L_final (A=7,K=30, theta=2.6, eps=1.2) with attention c=60 (c=80 collapsed, c=40 is 100%).
Final LTR chain (A=7,K=30,c=40, theta=2.4, eps=1.4): 4 blocks, d_model=42, 2 heads, 12 single-ReLU lookup neurons/block; clean docstring.
